content.description: hope.money centers on the distributed stablecoin $HOPE and seeks to deliver frictionless, transparent next-generation financial infrastructure accessible to all. By bridging CeFi and TradFi use cases with DeFi, the HOPE Ecosystem supports swap, lending, custody, clearing, and settlement, while encouraging active governance through $LT. Founded by Flex Yang in 2023, hope.money aims to broaden participation in digital finance and community-led stewardship. The project emphasizes openness, auditability, and inclusive governance, inviting users to participate in shaping future developments.
